topic_name: White House ballroom and broader construction taxpayer-cost claim

surface_claim.claim_text: The White House ballroom and other White House construction cost taxpayers $0.
surface_claim.office_or_role: Claim attribution remains bounded by the linked rhetoric record

claimed_justification.stated_basis: The 2025 White House announcement stated that President Trump and other donors committed funds necessary to build the ballroom structure.
claimed_justification.quoted_basis: Exact source wording is preserved through the governed White House source receipt; this machine record does not reproduce a long quotation.
claimed_justification.implied_basis: Private funding of a ballroom component is used as the asserted basis for a broader zero-taxpayer-cost proposition.

primary_records: 2026-08-14 NPS East Wing modernization / State Ballroom FONSI appendix
court_records: Government Supreme Court filing characterizes the East Wing undertaking as an integrated military complex including secure ballroom space.
independent_analysis: Bounded rhetoric assessment separates ballroom structure, integrated security project, and broader White House construction program.
unsupported_assertions: Final audited zero-taxpayer cost for the integrated project
Final public/private allocation for the broader White House construction program
Motive or intent inferred from any funding discrepancy
contradictions: The White House announcement pairs private ballroom funding language with separate Secret Service security enhancements and modifications.
Official project records describe an integrated East Wing modernization, ballroom, and security undertaking rather than only a detached ballroom purchase.

known_origin_points: White House announced private funding for an approximately $200 million ballroom structure.
White House assigned necessary security enhancements and modifications to the United States Secret Service.
Later official records characterize the undertaking as an integrated East Wing modernization and security project.
funding_or_donor_links: Federal transfer and obligation records remain incomplete
unknown_nodes: Exact source and destination of government transfers
Exact public/private allocation by project component

A categorical zero-taxpayer-cost proposition is under examination.

ledger_classification.classification_notes: The record supports separating private ballroom-component funding from the integrated project and broader program. Exact taxpayer share remains subject to primary transfer, obligation, contract, security-expenditure, and donor records.
